# Tawveeri - توفيري
# Price comparison platform for electronics and home appliances in Saudi Arabia

> توفيري هي منصة سعودية لمقارنة أسعار الإلكترونيات والأجهزة المنزلية من أكبر 8 متاجر في المملكة العربية السعودية.

## What is Tawveeri?
Tawveeri (توفيري) is Saudi Arabia's price comparison platform for electronics and home appliances. We compare prices from 8 major Saudi stores including Amazon SA, Noon, Jarir, Extra, Al-Mannai, Shaker, Samsung SA, and Al-Shita Wal-Saif.

## Key Features
- Real-time price comparison from 8 Saudi stores
- AI shopping assistant "Waffir" (وفّر) that understands Arabic dialects
- Price alerts when products reach your target price
- Coupon codes and deals
- 85,000+ products in database

## Stores We Compare
Amazon Saudi Arabia (amazon.sa), Noon (noon.com), Jarir Bookstore (jarir.com), Extra Stores (extrastores.com), Al-Mannai, Shaker, Samsung SA, Al-Shita Wal-Saif

## Categories
Smartphones, Laptops, Tablets, TVs, Audio, Gaming, Cameras, Monitors, Wearables, Smart Home, Appliances, Refrigerators, Kitchen, Personal Care, Accessories

## AI Assistant
Waffir AI (وفّر) — Arabic-speaking AI shopping assistant that finds the lowest price from 8 Saudi stores. Available at tawveeri.com/ar/assistant
